title: Can AI actually generate a playable game from just a written idea?
author: FantasticBreath8768
selftext: I’ve read a lot about AI in creative industries, from art to music, but I’m amazed by the idea that AI can help create video games. I wonder how far this technology has come can you really write a few sentences describing your game world and characters, and then have it transformed into something you can play? For someone who has a concept but no coding skills, this could be a game-changer. I’m also curious about how customizable the generated games are can you adjust themes, add co-op elements, or tweak the environment easily? I found a tool called Tessala which claims to do exactly that: convert text prompts into playable games. It’s interesting because it lets creators experiment with their ideas immediately without setting up a full game engine.
